# artifactkeeper_repository_label (Resource)

A single key/value label on a repository. A label is addressed by the repository key plus the label key; changing either forces a new label, while the value can be updated in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Label a repository with key/value metadata (used by sync policies, etc.). A
# label is identified by the repository key plus the label key; changing either
# forces a new label, while the value can be updated in place.
resource "artifactkeeper_repository_label" "env" {
  repository_key = artifactkeeper_repository.docker_local.key
  key            = "env"
  value          = "production"
}

# A key-only label (value defaults to an empty string).
resource "artifactkeeper_repository_label" "tier" {
  repository_key = artifactkeeper_repository.docker_local.key
  key            = "tier"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Label key. Changing this forces a new label.
- `repository_key` (String) Key of the repository the label is attached to. Changing this forces a new label.

### Optional

- `value` (String) Label value. Defaults to an empty string when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Label UUID assigned by Artifact Keeper.
- `repository_id` (String) UUID of the repository the label is attached to.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Repository labels import as "<repository_key>/<label_key>".
terraform import artifactkeeper_repository_label.env docker-local/env
```
